children: RNS Number : 1656T  Talon Resources PLC  03 September 2026
First hole underway at East Fornieri Bay as programme begins

Talon Resources plc (AIM: TAR), the North American gold exploration company, is pleased to announce that its maiden diamond drilling campaign has commenced at the Eagle Lake gold project in Ontario, Canada ("Eagle Lake" or the "Project").

The first hole is being drilled at East Fornieri Bay, the programme's highest-priority target, where Phase 1 channel sampling returned 4.80m @ 4.47 g/t Au including 1.0m @ 19.10 g/t Au and 1.85m @ 7.17 g/t Au including 0.50m @ 24.40 g/t Au (RNS: 22 July 2026).

The maiden programme comprises 11 diamond drill holes totalling 1,375m across five pads at four target areas: East Fornieri Bay, West Fornieri Bay, Cedar Trench and Moss Knoll. The programme is fully funded and is being managed by Critical Discoveries Corp., with Rodren Drilling Ltd. as drilling contractor.
Assay results are expected following programme completion and will be reported in batches as they are received.

Alex King, Chief Executive Officer, commented: "We are delighted to have the drill turning at Eagle Lake ahead of schedule.  This is a fully funded programme, targeting some of the strongest gold prospects recognised in this part of the Wabigoon Subprovince, identified through our own exploration work and MINML's proprietary PRISM machine learning platform, which has been used to refine target selection and optimise drill hole placement.  We believe the programme provides an important opportunity to test these targets and potentially advance our understanding of the Project's gold potential.

"MINML's work has demonstrated that 10 of the 16 cells covering the licence fall in the top one percent nationally for gold, placing Eagle Lake ahead of 62% of Canada's 242 past and present gold producers, which were scored on the same basis. The objective of this programme is to provide further physical support of this high-grade gold mineralisation, and we look forward to presenting our results over the remaining weeks of Q3 and into Q4 2026."

Cairn Financial Advisers LLP Nominated Adviser

Talon Resources plc (AIM: TAR) is a gold exploration company focused on high-impact discovery opportunities across North America. Its initial asset is the Eagle Lake gold project in Ontario's Wabigoon Subprovince, where it holds a 90% interest in a land package with multiple high-grade gold targets and significant exploration upside. Through its collaboration with MINML, Talon is also generating new targets across the Wabigoon Subprovince using machine learning-assisted prospectivity mapping, while continuing to evaluate additional opportunities elsewhere in North America.
